# DreamHost

> > DreamHost is a comprehensive web hosting platform offering managed WordPress hosting, AI-powered website building, domain registration, and professional email services with 100% uptime guarantee and NVMe SSD infrastructure.

DreamHost provides an integrated stack of web services including shared and VPS hosting, the Remixer AI website builder, domain registration across multiple TLDs, and professional email hosting. The platform emphasizes managed solutions, fast performance with NVMe SSD storage, and comprehensive support for small businesses and developers.

## Key Topics

- WordPress Hosting
- Remixer AI Website Builder
- NVMe SSD Storage
- Domain Registration
- SSL/TLS Certificates
- Email Hosting
- DreamPress (Managed WordPress)
- Web Hosting Plans
- DNS Management
- Domain Privacy
- Free WordPress Migration
- Professional Services
- 100% Uptime Guarantee
- CDN Integration
- AI Website Builder

- [WordPress Migration | Free Automated Migration](https://www.dreamhost.com/features/free-wordpress-migrations): Free automated WordPress migration to DreamHost with NGINX/CDN
